notes.title: Rhythmic Retro Racer Major Update 1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36645311/b6483f948dec6b7d6dbdc7113dcfbd454f9d4b59.png

Rhythmic Retro Racer May30th Major Update

1) Dynamic realistic day/ light system
2) Advanced and more quality shaders and reflections(adjustable in options menu)
3) Synch-Asynch System; if player follows the rhythym while getting the notes, it will get extra bonus for each treshold(100,250,500,1000 vs)
4) Chasing and maneouvring enemy Car!  
5) Player projectile (Bomb) system

Hope you like it! Please feel free to report any bugs you encounter in our community groups. Thank you!

notes.title: Rhythmic Retro Racer V1.04 (Racing & driving update)
notes.notes:
* A new Rhythm level & soundtrack added
* New driving system developed, still work in progress, we'll make it better for sure!
* 9 different drivable Retro and classic cars
* 2 racing levels
* 1 Time attack level
* 5 Rhythm Level
* New main menu system, hope you like it!
* New & advanced shaders, more quality graphics
* Fixed many bugs
